description: On a wet country road under a dark green storm sky, a huge tornado touches down over flat fields as lightning flashes. A young red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat and cap holds a camera whose flip-out screen shows the tornado she has just recorded. She shouts at first, then grins in excitement as two young men crowd in to stare at the screen, one clutching his head, and another young man with a large camera joins them. A muddy pickup truck and broken boards are behind them.

taps.phrase: to point at the camera screen
